candidates.derivation: L=140, W=70.5, H=4*7.4; no cell compression assumed
candidates.allowance_basis: Engineering reserve for end insulation/tab folds, outer protection and interlayers. Not manufacturer tolerance or certified swelling allowance. No specific BMS is included.

candidates.configuration: 4S2P, eight 3000mAh cells; 4 by 2 rectangular transverse grid, parallel axes
candidates.derivation: L=4*18.6, W=65.2 along cell axes, H=2*18.6; touching-cell theoretical lower envelope
candidates.allowance_basis: Unverified design reserve for intercell spacing, end insulation/interconnects and wrap; not a cell-holder or BMS drawing
candidates.caveat: 6000mAh is typical, not guaranteed minimum. Different form factor from table LiPo. Finished mass cannot be inferred by forcing the 500–650g estimate.

candidates.configuration: Same eight cylindrical cells in one transverse row
candidates.caveat: Exceeds default 155mm bay length; use expansion option if selected.

candidates.configuration: Ten P30B cells, 5 by 2 grid; NOT selected
candidates.caveat: Dimension alternative only. Electrical requirements differ; no automatic replacement of latest 4S table.

recommended_adjustable_design.target: Stacked 4S1P pouch family with removable spacer blocks and adjustable broad retention straps
recommended_adjustable_design.mounting_fit_policy: Retain gently using padded broad supports; do not treat all available height as prescribed pouch compression. Strap placement, loads, expansion and insulation remain unverified.
recommended_adjustable_design.optional_long_bay_reason: Accommodates the cited 178.2mm finished-pack example and flat eight-cell option, subject to clearance and connector routing; does not establish actual custom-pack fit.

lead_routing_zone.location: Beyond one short end of bay, +L direction
lead_routing_zone.purpose: Separate provisional lead exit, bend and strain-relief routing reserve

connector_service_keepout.location: Within lead zone; route so connector remains accessible
connector_service_keepout.purpose: Unselected connector and access placeholder, not an XT60/XT90 dimensional claim

protection_board.integration: Reserve/resize separately once electrical architecture selects protection; do not silently count an unknown board as covered.

confidence.reference_cell_geometry: Medium to high for published catalogue/datasheet values; pouch tolerance absent
confidence.derived_core_geometry: High conditional on specified layout and dimensions

design_limits: These are mechanical envelope alternatives, not a pack construction instruction or electrical validation.
